name: Marching Cubes Surface Area Estimation
aliases: Surface Area Estimation via Marching Cubes
definition: A method to estimate the surface area of a solid S by summing the areas of the polygonal faces (triangles) produced by the marching cubes algorithm approximating the frontier Vh(S).
summary: Marching Cubes Surface Area Estimation sums triangle areas from the marching cubes mesh to approximate surface extent, differing by focusing on aggregate area rather than normals, though it lacks multigrid convergence.
